candidate.title: SPLiT-seq
candidate.scope: The four-round SPLiT-seq cell workflow in the upper row of the supplied Illumina schematic: fixed/permeabilized cells containing poly(A) RNA undergo in-cell barcoded RT, two in-cell barcode ligations, and a fourth barcode/adaptor PCR after the combined lysis-and-split block. Three wells/tubes drawn per round are illustrative branches, not a claim that the implementation uses only three wells. The enlarged wells illustrate one branch, not additional transformations. The endpoint is amplified barcoded cDNA labeled Ready for library prep; downstream library construction, sequencing and analysis are not drawn operations. The partial sci-RNA-Seq row and right-side chemical legend are neighboring context, not alternative target workflows. The paper establishes SPLiT-seq compatibility with fixed nuclei too; this graph retains the depicted cell implementation.
